title: V-8 ENG. 350 CU. IN. SPEC. HI-PERF. - CONTENTS
summary: Contents of the LT1 option section (350 cu. in. special high-performance small-block V-8): non-illustrated parts (A2), generator and pump mounting (A3), pulleys and belts (A4), air pipes, hoses and diverter valve (A5), gas pipes, fuel pump and transmission controlled spark system (A6), and hood paint stripe (B1). An engine drawing shows where each sheet applies; View A shows the engine I.D. code and V.I.N. location on the cylinder case pad.
notes: View A: ENGINE I.D. CODE; CYLINDER CASE PAD
V.I.N. LOCATION-SEE UPC 0 SHEET B2 FOR SPECS.
